D1.title: Home 'Needs you' lists Progress cards?
D1.lead: Study decision 2, open since 21 Oct: should the Home page's 'Needs you' list also show the Progress-page cards, so there is one place to look for asks?

options.label: Yes (suggested)
options.body: Home 'Needs you' lists every open Progress card and links to it. One place to check; the Progress tab stays the detail view. OTM scopes it as a small PR for you to merge.
options.reply: Study decision 2: yes. Home 'Needs you' lists Progress cards.

options.label: No
options.body: Keep Home as it is. Progress cards stay on the Progress tab only.
options.reply: Study decision 2: no. Home stays as it is; Progress cards stay on the Progress tab.
